JUDGE BURST J1-knight — Run C-9 M1 style gate. task_id "J1-knight". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Candidates are single-character master frames on flat green.
Image 1 = candidate P; Image 2 = candidate Q; Image 3 = candidate R; Image 4 = candidate S; Image 5 = candidate T; Image 6 = the IDENTITY reference and MANUSCRIPT anchor (axes 1 and 3).
Score each candidate on axes 1–5 (integers 1–5) with ONE-LINE reasons each: 1 PAINTED-BOOK FIDELITY — does the subject, palette and iconography read as a page of a late-medieval illuminated manuscript brought to life (compare the manuscript anchor)? · 2 WATERCOLOR-AND-INK HAND — pen-and-ink contour, hand-drawn hatching, transparent washes laid unevenly (pooling, granulation, blooms), pale paper-like highlights; NOT a digital painting, render or airbrushed gradient · 3 OBEDIENCE — identity matches the reference knight: full plate, closed rounded helm visor down, BLUE tabard with GOLD cross-crosslets and GOLD diagonal bands, a POLEAXE; and NO pleated skirt below the tabard (plate thighs visible) · 4 GAME READABILITY — the silhouette reads clearly when mentally reduced to 130 px tall (helm, poleaxe, tabard distinct) · 5 CAMERA — seen from ABOVE at about 53 degrees (top of helm and shoulders clearly visible, feet seen from above), facing down-right; eye-level views score ≤ 2. Judge every candidate independently; do not assume any is a control; do not guess which image generator or register produced any image. Write out/judgment.json: {"task_id":..., "candidates": {"<label>": {"axes": [a1,a2,a3,a4,a5], "reasons": [5 one-line strings], "notes": "<one line>"}}, "ranking": [labels best→worst]}. view_image only. No image generation, no code, no web, no other files. RETURN: receipt task_id; images = []; calls_used = 0; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 6 — the IDENTITY reference and MANUSCRIPT anchor (axes 1 and 3)
